title: Wallet top-up with saved cards
executive_summary: ECR-2026-020 (Wallet top-up with saved cards) is a backend change in the Payments domain, scored 78/100 (CRITICAL). It touches REQ-1001 (Card Payment Authorization), REQ-1027 (Wallet Balance Integrity), REQ-1039 (Gift Card Redemption). History is relevant here: BUG-101 (Currency conversion failed for unsupported currencies), BUG-201 (Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes), BUG-332 (Refund service failed after payment validation change). Decisions already recorded: Decision: credit the wallet only on capture, never on authorisation. BUG-407 shows what happens when the balance check and debit are not atomic. Open concern: BUG-201 was reopened twice because the fix only checked code length. Please add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion to the regression pack, not just the merchant list check. Recommended regression: 49 of 170 tests (71.2% reduction), 1 P0 and 9 P1. Evidence is missing for: REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1004, REQ-1008.

ecr_overview.title: Wallet top-up with saved cards
ecr_overview.description: Introduce wallet top-ups with saved cards in the Digital Wallet Service. The top-up is a card payment through the Payment Service and the API Gateway; the wallet balance is credited only after capture and posted to the Ledger Service.

matched_requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Wallet Balance Integrity
matched_requirements.description: The Digital Wallet Service shall never allow a balance below zero, shall apply top-ups only after payment capture and shall post every balance movement to the ledger.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Gift Card Redemption
matched_requirements.description: The Gift Card Service shall issue gift cards with an expiry date, reject redemption after expiry in the card's timezone and credit redemptions to the wallet.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-034 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Transaction Ledger Consistency
matched_requirements.description: Every captured payment and refund shall produce balanced double-entry ledger postings; the ledger shall reconcile to the transaction store daily.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-015 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
matched_requirements.description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Subscription Renewal Charging
matched_requirements.description: The Subscription Billing Service shall charge each renewal in the plan currency and retry failed renewals on a schedule before suspending the subscription.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-021 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Merchant Payout Release
matched_requirements.description: The Merchant Payout Service shall release payouts only to merchants with an approved KYC status and only for settled ledger balances.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-024 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Payment Validation Rules Engine
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Validator shall validate amount, currency code, merchant configuration and payment instrument before any authorisation call, returning a deterministic list of validation errors.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
matched_requirements.description: Payment requests carrying a currency code outside the merchant's supported currency list shall be rejected with error UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Multi Currency Payment Processing
matched_requirements.description: The platform shall accept payments in every enabled settlement currency, converting to the merchant settlement currency using the rate effective at authorisation time and storing both amounts.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: ECR-2026-020 (Wallet top-up with saved cards) is a backend change in the Payments domain, scored 78/100 (CRITICAL). It touches REQ-1001 (Card Payment Authorization), REQ-1027 (Wallet Balance Integrity), REQ-1039 (Gift Card Redemption). History is relevant here: BUG-101 (Currency conversion failed for unsupported currencies), BUG-201 (Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes), BUG-332 (Refund service failed after payment validation change). Decisions already recorded: Decision: credit the wallet only on capture, never on authorisation. BUG-407 shows what happens when the balance check and debit are not atomic. Open concern: BUG-201 was reopened twice because the fix only checked code length. Please add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion to the regression pack, not just the merchant list check. Recommended regression: 49 of 170 tests (71.2% reduction), 1 P0 and 9 P1. Evidence is missing for: REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1004, REQ-1008.
